EmDash.PORT: Gateway listener; Railway's public domain and health check use it.
EmDash.GATEWAY_USERNAME: Username for the browser password prompt in front of the EmDash admin panel and first-run setup.
EmDash.GATEWAY_PASSWORD: Generated password for the admin panel's browser prompt. Letters and digits, 16 or more. Share it only with people who edit the site.
EmDash.GATEWAY_ADMIN_GATE: admin: the prompt guards the admin panel and setup. setup: only the setup API, which EmDash closes itself once setup is done; editors then sign in with passkeys alone.
EmDash.EMDASH_APP_ADDRESS: Private address of the EmDash App service.
EmDash.GATEWAY_TRUSTED_PROXIES: Railway's edge range; the visitor address it reports is passed to EmDash for rate limits.

EmDash App.PORT: Private Node listener the gateway forwards to; Railway's health check calls /_emdash/api/health on it.
EmDash App.HOST: Listen on IPv6 and IPv4 so Railway's private network reaches the site.
EmDash App.EMDASH_SITE_URL: Public origin of the site. Passkeys, links and setup use it. Change it when you add a custom domain to the EmDash service, then redeploy.
EmDash App.EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY: Generated key that encrypts secret plugin settings. Keep a copy outside Railway; a database restored without it cannot read those settings.
EmDash App.EMDASH_TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADERS: Header the gateway sets to the visitor's address, used by EmDash's rate limits.
